description: This file defines a React component 'DimensionDragInput' for adjusting width or height of an element within a drawing application, including handling cropping, aspect ratio, and frame updates.

methods.name: _shouldKeepAspectRatio
methods.description: Determines if aspect ratio should be maintained, based on element type being 'image'.

methods.name: handleDimensionChange
methods.description: Handles updates to element dimensions based on user input, including cropping, direct value input, and slider dragging, with aspect ratio and frame considerations.

methods.name: handleDragFinished
methods.description: Finalizes resize operations, updating frame memberships if necessary.

methods.name: DimensionDragInput
methods.description: React component rendering a drag input for width or height, managing value display and invoking handlers.
